description:
Protein, CDS or cDNA sequence of a gene, as FASTA. kind: 'protein' (default), 'cds' or 'cdna'. gene: an Ensembl
Plants gene ID or transcript ID of any genome on this site (wheat RefSeq v1.0/v1.1/v2.1 IDs and symbols are
converted to v1.1 first). Local BLAST protein/CDS databases first, then the Ensembl REST API. Gives the longest
transcript unless all_transcripts. Use it when someone asks for a gene's sequence, or before blast_sequence /
primer design. Sequences come from the gene models: say which assembly.
name: gene_sequence
